Aircraft Starter
Teardown

Project Engineer · CATIA V5 · GD&T Full mechanical teardown & digital reconstruction of a Sky-Tec FAA-PMA 149-NL aircraft starter — modeled, dimensioned, and improved for reliability.
AMAT_MEDA_MAIN_ASSEMBLYCATIA · exploded

Reverse-engineered a complete starter motor into a parametric 3D assembly, then produced a full 2D drawing set to GD&T standards — analyzing vibration & torque-transfer along the way.

  • 3D models + 2D drawings authored in CATIA V5
  • GD&T applied for tolerance & dimensioning
  • Mechanical improvements to reduce vibration & torque issues
  • Process docs + technical presentations delivered

§ 05 — PROFILE

About

I'm an engineering student at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University who likes taking things apart, modeling them precisely, and putting something better back together.

My work spans reverse-engineering real aircraft hardware in CATIA V5, conceptual aircraft design with MATLAB performance analysis, and — most of all — Slingshot Aeronautics, the humanitarian UAV startup I founded. There I'm designing a fixed-wing platform to flight-test automatic stability on PX4, paired with Python software that plans and optimizes delivery missions to rural communities. Whether it's a single dimensioned part or a full flight system, I care about precision, iteration, and clear documentation.
